.kw-page .kw-section{padding:100px max(28px,calc((100% - 1320px)/2));gap:24px}.kw-page .kw-section h2.elementor-heading-title{font-size:clamp(32px,3.8vw,56px);line-height:1.05}.kw-page .kw-section h3.elementor-heading-title{font-size:22px;line-height:1.25}.kw-page .kw-section .elementor-widget-text-editor{font-size:18px;line-height:1.78}

/* Kanawa preview: editorial structure, responsive layouts and section navigation. */
.kw-page{--kw-ink:#143b48;--kw-blue:#087b9b;--kw-line:#d8e9e7;--kw-teal:#168ca8;--kw-gold:#e6bd4c;--kw-pad:max(28px,calc((100vw - 1320px)/2));font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans',sans-serif}

.kw-page .kw-intro{padding:clamp(56px,7vw,96px) var(--kw-pad) 0;gap:20px}.kw-page .kw-intro .elementor-widget-text-editor{max-width:740px}.kw-page .kw-intro .elementor-widget-text-editor:first-child p{font-family:Fraunces,Georgia,serif;font-size:clamp(24px,2.5vw,34px);font-weight:600;line-height:1.4;color:var(--kw-ink)}
.kw-page .kw-section:not(.kw-intro){padding:clamp(72px,8vw,120px) var(--kw-pad);gap:48px}.kw-page .kw-section-head{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;align-items:end;gap:0 72px}.kw-page .kw-section-head .elementor-widget-text-editor p{margin:0;max-width:460px}.kw-page .kw-section-head .elementor-heading-title{margin:0}

.kw-page .kw-tabs{display:flex;gap:34px;border-bottom:1px solid #cde2e4}.kw-page .kw-tabs button{padding:0 0 16px;border:0;border-bottom:2px solid transparent;background:none;color:#5d7983}.kw-page .kw-tabs button[aria-selected=true]{border-color:#168ca8;color:#143b48}.kw-page .kw-panel{padding:0;border:0}.kw-page.kw-tabs-ready .kw-panel[hidden]{display:none!important}
.kw-page .kw-access .kw-grid,.kw-page .kw-season .kw-grid{gap:32px}.kw-page .kw-access .kw-group,.kw-page .kw-season .kw-group{position:relative;border-top:1px solid #cde2e4;padding-top:24px}.kw-page .kw-access .kw-group:before,.kw-page .kw-season .kw-group:before{content:'';position:absolute;top:-1px;left:0;width:36px;height:2px;background:var(--kw-gold)}

/* This header belongs only to the Kanawa page. */

body:has(.kw-page) .site-content>.ast-container>#primary{margin:0;width:100%}

.kw-page{width:100%;max-width:none;gap:0!important}

.kw-page .kw-hero{width:100%;min-height:100svh}.kw-page .kw-hero-button .elementor-button{text-transform:none;letter-spacing:0}.kw-page .kw-hero-meta{font-weight:500}.kw-page .kw-site-header a:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #0077b6;outline-offset:3px}

/* Three ways: match the preview's split panel and tab rhythm. */
.kw-page .kw-experiences .kw-section-head{direction:ltr;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:0 72px;align-items:end}
.kw-page .kw-experiences .kw-section-head>.elementor-widget-heading{grid-column:2;grid-row:1}.kw-page .kw-experiences .kw-section-head>.elementor-widget-text-editor{grid-column:1;grid-row:1}
.kw-page .kw-experiences .kw-photo{margin:0 0 8px}.kw-page .kw-experiences .kw-photo img{aspect-ratio:21/9;object-fit:cover;object-position:center 46%;border-radius:20px}
.kw-page .kw-experiences .kw-tabs{gap:34px}.kw-page .kw-experiences .kw-panel{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:0 72px;align-items:start;padding:8px 0 0}

/* Kanawa saja: hilangkan ruang bawaan tema dan container Elementor. */
body:has(.kw-page) { margin: 0 !important; }
body:has(.kw-page) #content > .ast-container,
body:has(.kw-page) #primary,
body:has(.kw-page) #main,
body:has(.kw-page) #main > .ast-article-single,
body:has(.kw-page) #main > .ast-article-single > .entry-content,
body:has(.kw-page) .entry-content > .elementor {
  box-sizing: border-box;
  width: 100%;
  max-width: none;
  margin: 0 !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
}
body:has(.kw-page) .kw-page.e-con {
  --padding-top: 0px; --padding-right: 0px;
  --padding-bottom: 0px; --padding-left: 0px;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  width: 100%;
  max-width: none;
  margin: 0 !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
}

/* Anchor, layout, dan navigasi: diselaraskan dengan preview Kanawa. */
.kw-page [id^="kw-"] { scroll-margin-top: 135px; }
.kw-page .kw-intro { align-items: flex-start; }
.kw-page .kw-intro > .elementor-widget-text-editor { width: min(100%, 740px) !important; max-width: 740px; }
.kw-page .kw-intro > .elementor-widget-text-editor:first-child .elementor-widget-container p { font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; font-size: clamp(24px,2.5vw,34px); font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.4; }
.kw-page .kw-nav a[aria-current="location"] { background: #087b9b !important; color: #fff !important; }
.kw-page .kw-access .kw-section-head, .kw-page .kw-season .kw-section-head { width: 100%; }
.kw-page .kw-access .kw-grid, .kw-page .kw-season .kw-grid { display: grid; width: 100%; gap: 32px; }
.kw-page .kw-access .kw-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr)); }
.kw-page .kw-season .kw-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr)); }
.kw-page .kw-access .kw-grid > .kw-group, .kw-page .kw-season .kw-grid > .kw-group { width: 100%; min-width: 0; gap: 10px; padding: 24px 0 0; }
.kw-page .kw-access .kw-group:before, .kw-page .kw-season .kw-group:before { top: -1px; }
.kw-page .kw-access .kw-group:after { order: -1; color: #066c82; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .08em; }
.kw-page .kw-access .kw-group:nth-child(1):after {content:'01'}
.kw-page .kw-access .kw-group:nth-child(2):after {content:'02'}

Kanawa Island:
A Peaceful Coast That Feels
Like Your Private Escape

settings.editor: A quiet beach, clear water, and room to slow down in Labuan Bajo.

settings._title: Metadata · Penulis, waktu baca dan bagikan
settings.html: By Kapalsantai3 min read
Why Kanawa?Things to doGetting thereWhen to visitWhat to bring

settings.editor: A stretch of pale sand, clear shallows, and a hill rising above the shore. Kanawa Island invites you to slow down and enjoy the space between one adventure and the next.
Spend the morning looking beneath the surface, take a short walk for a wider view, or simply settle in by the water. Here’s what to know before adding Kanawa to your boat trip.

settings.title: Three reasons to stop at Kanawa

settings.editor: From the shoreline to the hill, each perspective reveals a different side of the island.
Clear shallows offer a chance to see fish and coral. Visibility and sightings vary with conditions.
A sandy shoreline makes space for a slower pause between destinations.
The island’s hill offers a wider perspective across the water and nearby islands.

settings.title: Three ways to spend your time

settings.editor: Pick one, or mix them all. Kanawa can be as active or as unhurried as your itinerary allows.
Best for unhurried time
Settle on the sand, enjoy the view, or watch the light change across the water. Sunrise and sunset are especially appealing when your itinerary allows an early or late stop.

• Bring a towel and find a spot at the water’s edge.
  • Use the beach and hilltop for different photo perspectives.
  • Take your time and leave the shoreline as you found it.
Best for snorkeling
Snorkel when conditions and your guide allow, looking for fish and coral along the way. Sightings vary with the day, so treat anything you see as a bonus.
Ask your operator about diving options and the day’s conditions before you enter the water.

• Wear a life jacket or snorkel vest if you’re not a confident swimmer.
  • Avoid touching or standing on the reef.
  • Use reef-safe sunscreen to protect the coral.

settings._title: Paragraf · Walk up for the view 1
settings.editor: A short hill walk may offer panoramic views across the water and nearby islands. It is a gentle way to add a different perspective to your beach day.

settings._title: Paragraf · Walk up for the view 2
settings.editor: Check with your guide about access, the route, and current trail conditions.

settings._title: Daftar · Walk up for the view
settings.editor:
• Wear sturdy sandals or shoes with good grip.
  • Carry water and a hat for the exposed sections.
  • Go earlier or later in the day to avoid the strongest sun.

settings.title: How to get to Kanawa Island

settings.editor: Kanawa is reached by sea, so the trip itself becomes part of the day.
Join your boat at the harbor and set out across the water.
Travel time depends on the vessel, route, and sea conditions.
Some trips may also visit Manjarite, Siaba, or Sebayur. Confirm your itinerary with your operator.
Step onto the sand and spend the time that suits your itinerary.

settings.title: Best time to visit Kanawa Island

settings.editor: April to October is generally the dry season, which tends to suit boat days best.
